paragraphs.text: Kinnan , Bonder Prodigy , is a human druid on the plane of Ikoria .

Kinnan is a very young bonder , considered a prodigy among them. This is because while most bonders have only one monster companion , some like Kinnan can bond with many. The planeswalker Vivien Reid tried to ask him how he did it, but he just growled at her before riding off on the back of one of his beasts. Having grown up with monsters, Kinnan doesn't know much about manners.
